title: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.05745v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. translated_title: 超越分布内性能保持：通过面向脆弱性的调优恢复量化视觉-语言-动作模型的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 后训练量化已被证明能在标准评估条件下保持VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）的性能，但其在多大程度上保留了全精度模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力仍缺乏深入研究。在本研究中，我们系统研究了量化后VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。实证结果表明，量化策略尽管保持了相当的分布内性能，但在面对细微的环境变化时可能变得脆弱。我们进一步观察到，动作差异集中于少量回放状态，而教师指导的效果因差异程度而异：在高差异状态下能提升泛化能力，但在低差异状态下反而可能损害泛化能力。这些发现表明，有效的量化后恢复需要对脆弱状态进行选择性干预，而非对学生模型进行全局蒸馏。
tldr: 该研究揭示量化VLA模型在环境扰动下虽保持分布内性能却变得脆弱，发现动作差异集中于少数脆弱状态且教师指导在高差异状态提升泛化、在低差异状态反而损害泛化，据此提出面向脆弱状态的选择性调优方法以恢复量化模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that quantized VLAs become fragile under environmental perturbations despite preserving in-distribution performance, identifies that action discrepancies concentrate on a small subset of vulnerable states where teacher guidance has opposite effects at high- versus low-discrepancy states, and proposes vulnerability-oriented selective tuning rather than global distillation to recover generalization.
